snippet.title: Detective INNA DUKE trailer
snippet.description:
We’re excited to present the trailer for a new game from HmarkaTeam — Detective INNA DUKE. It’s a detective visual novel with puzzle elements, filled with humor and an engaging story. You can try the demo and add it to your wishlist at the link below 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4222040/Detective_INNA_DUKE/
